PM Modi receives digital death threat before Australia visit; probe launched

Prime Minister Narendra Modi reportedly received a digital death threat prior to a scheduled community event in Melbourne, Australia. The threat appeared beneath a Facebook post announcing the event. Australian police are investigating the incident and reportedly identified an IP address linked to the social media post.
